data.one_liner: A Dart library to parse, build, and manipulate source map v3 files.
data.what_it_does: Provides data types, parsers, and builders for working with the source map version 3 specification. It allows tools to read mapping information between generated output and original source code or programmatically generate source maps. It also integrates with source_span for tracking precise file locations and reporting errors.
use_when: You are building compilers, transpilers, or code-generation tools that emit source maps.
You need to parse existing source maps to translate generated file locations back to source files.
You are building developer tooling that needs to display contextual errors referencing original source positions.
avoid_when: You only need to translate stack traces in Dart applications (use source_map_stack_trace instead).
General Flutter app development that does not involve compiling or manipulating source code mappings.
strengths: Official Dart team package adhering to the standard source map version 3 specification.
Includes both builder and parser capabilities for source maps.
Deeply integrates with the standard source_span package for file location tracking.
weaknesses: Low-level utility with minimal usage documentation in the README.
Unnecessary for standard client-side Flutter application logic.
